name: Deputy Feldon
summary: South of the Great Lakeshire Bridge, Deputy Feldon watches the road into Lakeshire. Gnoll packs are creeping toward the town, and he keeps a nervous vigil.

sections.title: A Guard on Edge
sections.body: Deputy Feldon stands watch south of the Lakeshire bridge, guarding a road needed for trade and travel. Blackrock orcs press from the north while gnoll packs overrun the southern hills, stretching the town guard thin. Feldon cannot leave his post without weakening Lakeshire's perimeter. He depends on passing adventurers to drive back the gnolls before they cut the town off.

faq.answer: Deputy Feldon serves in the Lakeshire town guard, stationed just south of the bridge to the main southern road in Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Why is Deputy Feldon worried about gnolls?
faq.answer: Gnoll camps have been spotted along the road toward Elwynn Forest. Feldon fears they may push into the human homeland, leaving Lakeshire no longer the only town under siege. The guard is ill-equipped to face them.

faq.q: Why doesn't Feldon deal with the gnolls himself?
faq.answer: The Lakeshire guard is understaffed and facing orcs and gnolls at once. Feldon cannot leave his bridge post without leaving the town entrance unguarded.

faq.q: Where can Deputy Feldon be found?
faq.answer: Deputy Feldon stands watch on the road just south of the Great Lakeshire Bridge, guarding the town's southern approaches.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion, you can see how strained Stormwind's outer territories are: local guardsmen need passing champions to help keep the king's peace.
